Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in synthesizing the nationality data. After correctly identifying that Kreesha Turner is Canadian and Samantha Jo (Samantha Win) is Canadian-American (holding both Canadian and American nationalities), the Planner incorrectly concluded in Step 3 that "they do not share the same nationality." This is a failure to recognize that sharing *any* nationality (in this case, Canadian) satisfies the condition of "sharing the same nationality." The Planner focused on the difference (American citizenship) rather than the commonality (Canadian citizenship), leading to a premature and incorrect negative conclusion before verifying the final pages.
